description: Scan a PDF file for accessibility issues using PDF/UA checks. Checks tagging, structure, language, alt text, bookmarks, forms, and more.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the PDF file

reportPath.description: File path to write a markdown accessibility report

sarifPath.description: File path to write SARIF 2.1.0 output

name: scan_pdf_document

component.description: Component or template, when the defect repeats.

evidence.description: The offending markup, value or measurement.

location.description: Where the defect is, precisely enough to open.

notes.description: Anything a person must decide, and anything that could not be checked.

passed.description: Checks that ran and found nothing, so 'clean' is distinguishable from 'not checked'.

title: Scan PDF Document for Accessibility
